title: Prepositions of Place
summary: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address
rule: In = enclosed | On = surface | At = point/address
examples: The garden is behind the house.
The car is in front of the building.
The bank is between the café and the pharmacy.

commonMistakes.incorrect: The garden WRONG behind the house.
commonMistakes.correct: The garden is behind the house.
commonMistakes.explanation: Review the rule for this lesson.

tutorHints: Focus on Prepositions of Place with short drills.
Give Portuguese support only when the learner is stuck.
